description: This file implements the Sys Setup Manager Object for a BroadWay Runtime System, including functions for creating, initializing, enrolling objects, and removing the Sys Setup Manager, as well as related interface handling and internal state management.

classes.name: SYS_SETUP_MANAGER_OBJECT
classes.description: The main object representing the Sys Setup Manager, containing members for configuration, interface pointers, and function pointers for management operations.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE SysSmoCreate(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Constructs and initializes a new Sys Setup Manager object, setting up member functions and context handles.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SysSmoRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Cleans up and destroys the Sys Setup Manager object, freeing associated resources.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SysSmoEnrollObjects(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Enrolls and initializes all subordinate objects and interfaces required by the Sys Setup Manager.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SysSmoInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Performs member initialization for the Sys Setup Manager object, including setting default properties and function pointers.
